name: skill-conductor
description: Design, evaluate, improve, port, and package reliable agent skills across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, and Agent Skills-compatible hosts.

interface.longDescription: Turns tasks, workflows, prompts, SOPs, or existing skills into portable, robust agent skills. Designs architecture before writing, calibrates freedom by consequence, builds trigger and negative-trigger coverage, runs structural and behavioral evaluations, pressure-tests brittle rules, compiles host adapters, and packages installable skills.
defaultPrompt: Design a production-quality Skill for this workflow and prove why the Skill is needed.
Audit this Skill for triggering, instruction quality, portability, and regression risk.
Convert this workflow into a portable Skill for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and compatible agents.
